display.title: T1: Ore Doubling
display.subtitle: Build a Crushing Wheel pair
description: The first engineering payoff is §bore doubling§r. A pair of §bCrushing
Wheels§r turns one ore into two crushed nuggets' worth of ingot - the 2x
step that anchors the whole Tier 1 economy.
Set up rotational power (water wheel or hand crank), then build a Crushing
Wheel. You need two facing each other to actually crush, but having one in
hand is enough to complete this beat.
§7A Crushing Wheel banks §e25§7 Engineering tokens each (cap 2). Cross-link:
§7see §eCreate: The Brass Age§7 in Overworld Foundations for brass.
